# Moul UI — Full Component Reference

> Complete API reference for `@moul-dev/web-component` v1.0.0-alpha.2: every `<moul-*>` custom element with its attributes, JavaScript properties, events, slots, and CSS parts, derived from the Custom Elements Manifest.

<!-- Generated by `bun run sync:llms --write` from ui/dist/custom-elements.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Setup

```bash
bun add @moul-dev/web-component
# or
npm install @moul-dev/web-component
```

```js
// Registers every <moul-*> custom element (side-effect import).
import '@moul-dev/web-component'
// CSS token layer: colors, spacing, radii, typography, motion.
import '@moul-dev/web-component/style.css'
```

Without a bundler, load the self-contained CDN build (Lit and the other dependencies inlined):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/web-component/dist/assets/style.css" />
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/web-component/dist/cdn/moul-ui.js"></script>
```

`dist/moul-ui.js` (the package entry) keeps `lit`, `@lit/context`, `@lit-labs/virtualizer`, `motion`, and `d3-*` as bare imports so a bundler shares one copy of Lit with your app. Do not load it directly in a `<script>` tag.

## Conventions

- **Imports**: `import '@moul-dev/web-component'` once registers every `<moul-*>` element. Import design tokens with `import '@moul-dev/web-component/style.css'`. Motion controllers and effect elements live in a second entry, `import '@moul-dev/web-component/effects'`; an app that never imports it ships none of that code. There is no `@moul-dev/web-component/react`, `@moul-dev/web-component/tokens`, or `@moul-dev/web-component/tokens.stylex` entry point.
- **Markup, not JSX components**: Write native custom element tags (`<moul-button>`), never PascalCase components (`<Button>`). They work in plain HTML, Astro, Lit, Vue, Svelte, and React 19.
- **Attributes are kebab-case**: Boolean state uses presence attributes such as `is-disabled`, `is-open`, `is-checked`, `is-required`. The matching JS property is camelCase (`el.isDisabled = true`).
- **Rich data is set as properties**: Arrays, objects, and functions (`data`, `series`, `columns`, `items`, `logs`, `valueFormatter`) are assigned in JavaScript, not serialized into attributes.
- **Events are DOM events**: Listen with `addEventListener` (`press`, `change`, `input`, `openchange`, `selectionchange`, `pagechange`, `dismiss`). Payloads live on `event.detail`. There is no `onPress` prop.
- **Overlays**: Toggle `is-open` (or `el.isOpen`) on `<moul-modal>`, `<moul-drawer>`, `<moul-alert-dialog>`, `<moul-popover>`, `<moul-tooltip>`, `<moul-hover-card>`, `<moul-command-palette>`, `<moul-notification-bell>`, `<moul-expandable-card>`, `<moul-focus-mode>`, and react to `openchange` (`detail.isOpen`). Start a `<moul-tour>` with `start()`; its `openchange` also carries `detail.isComplete`.
- **Forms**: Inputs are form-associated via `ElementInternals`; give each a `name` and it submits with a native `<form>` / `FormData`. Enter in `<moul-text-field>`, `<moul-number-field>`, or `<moul-search-field>` submits its `<form>` or `<moul-form>` like a native input, so do not add your own Enter handler.
- **Semantic tones & variants**: `tone` is one of `primary | accent | success | warning | error`; surface `variant` is one of `solid | flat | shadow | bordered | glass`. Omit `variant` for a neutral surface: an unset `variant` on `<moul-card>`, `<moul-alert>`, `<moul-toast>`, or `<moul-stat>` renders the plain `--color-surface` look, while `variant="flat"` tints it in the tone. `<moul-button>` has its own `variant` set (`primary | secondary | tertiary | outline | ghost | danger | danger-soft`).
- **Accessibility**: Icon-only buttons (`is-icon`) and dot badges (`is-dot`) must have an `aria-label`.
- **Theming**: Override `--brand-hue`, `--brand-chroma-multiplier`, `--brand-font-family`, `--brand-font-scale`, `--brand-radius-factor`, and `--brand-density-factor` on `:root` (or any ancestor). Style internals through `::part(...)`.

## Exported JavaScript Helpers

- `toastQueue` — singleton queue: `toastQueue.add({ title, description, tone, variant, duration })` returns an id; mounts `<moul-toast>` elements into a `<moul-toast-region>`.
- `generatePagination(currentPage, totalPages, siblingCount)` — page list with ellipsis markers used by `<moul-pagination>`.
- `parseLogs`, `parseLogLine`, `parseAttributes`, `stripAttributes`, `normalizeLogLevel` — log parsing utilities behind `<moul-logs>`.
- Reactive controllers: `PressController`, `LayoutIndicatorController`, `OverlayPresenceController`, `NumberSpringController`, `FormInternalsController`.
- `SEMANTIC_TONES`, `VISUAL_VARIANTS`, `normalizeTone`, `normalizeVariant`, `semanticToneStyles` — tone/variant system for authoring your own elements.

---

# Charts & Data Visualization

## AreaChart

Area chart with optional stacking that you scrub with the pointer or arrow keys (slider semantics), and that morphs between data sets such as 7/30/90-day ranges. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/areachart](/docs/components/charts/areachart)

```html
<moul-area-chart id="revenue" label="Revenue" x-key="month" height="280" stacked></moul-area-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#revenue')
chart.data = [
  { month: 'Jan', web: 120, mobile: 80 },
  { month: 'Feb', web: 160, mobile: 95 },
]
chart.series = [
  { key: 'web', name: 'Web' },
  { key: 'mobile', name: 'Mobile' },
]
```

### `<moul-area-chart>`

Class: `MoulAreaChart` · Source: `ui/src/components/AreaChart/AreaChart.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `x-key` | `xKey` | `string` | `'name'` |
| `height` | `height` | `number` | `300` |
| `stacked` | `stacked` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `show-grid` | `showGrid` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `scrub` | `scrub` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` |

**Properties** (JavaScript only — set on the element instance)

| Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown>[]` | `[]` |
| `series` | `ChartSeries[]` | `[]` |
| `valueFormatter` | `(value: any) => string \| undefined` | `undefined` |

**Events**

| Event | Type |
| :--- | :--- |
| `point-hover` | `CustomEvent` |
| `point-leave` | `CustomEvent` |

**Slots**

| Slot |
| :--- |
| `empty` |

**CSS Parts:** `container`, `scrub-guide`, `scrub-dot`, `empty`, `svg`, `grid`, `x-axis`, `series`, `area`, `line`, `stroke`, `points`, `point`

## BarChart

Vertical or horizontal bar chart with grouped or stacked series. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/barchart](/docs/components/charts/barchart)

```html
<moul-bar-chart id="signups" x-key="day" layout="vertical" show-grid></moul-bar-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#signups')
chart.data = [{ day: 'Mon', count: 12 }, { day: 'Tue', count: 18 }]
chart.series = [{ key: 'count', name: 'Sign-ups' }]
```

## LineChart

Multi-series line chart with pointer and keyboard scrubbing; `is-live` turns it into a real-time feed with `push()`, `max-points`, a gliding line and a pause button. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/linechart](/docs/components/charts/linechart)

```html
<moul-line-chart id="latency" label="Latency" x-key="time" is-live max-points="40"></moul-line-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#latency')
chart.series = [{ key: 'p50', name: 'p50' }, { key: 'p99', name: 'p99' }]
chart.valueFormatter = (v) => `${v} ms`
setInterval(() => chart.push({ time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), p50: 40, p99: 160 }), 1000)
```

### `<moul-line-chart>`

Class: `MoulLineChart` · Source: `ui/src/components/LineChart/LineChart.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `x-key` | `xKey` | `string` | `'name'` |
| `height` | `height` | `number` | `300` |
| `show-grid` | `showGrid` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `curve` | `curve` | `string` | `'monotoneX'` |
| `scrub` | `scrub` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` |
| `is-live` | `isLive` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-paused` | `isPaused` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `max-points` | `maxPoints` | `number` | `0` |

## DoughnutChart

Doughnut, pie or half-circle chart whose centre shows the hovered slice; set `value`/`min`/`max` for a gauge that sweeps and counts to each new value. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/doughnutchart](/docs/components/charts/doughnutchart)

```html
<moul-doughnut-chart id="traffic" center-label="12.4k" center-sublabel="Visits"></moul-doughnut-chart>
<moul-doughnut-chart shape="half" height="170" value="72" center-sublabel="Disk used"></moul-doughnut-chart>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#traffic').data = [
  { name: 'Direct', value: 5400 },
  { name: 'Search', value: 4100 },
  { name: 'Social', value: 2900 },
]
```

### `<moul-doughnut-chart>`

## HeatmapChart

Contributions-style calendar of daily totals, or a weekday × hour punch card (`mode="hour"`) from the same timestamps. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/heatmapchart](/docs/components/charts/heatmapchart)

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Activity" description="Daily contributions">
  <moul-tabs slot="header" selected-key="calendar">
    <moul-tab key="calendar">Calendar</moul-tab>
    <moul-tab key="hour">By hour</moul-tab>
  </moul-tabs>
  <moul-heatmap-chart id="activity" unit="contributions"></moul-heatmap-chart>
</moul-chart-container>
```

```js
const heatmap = document.querySelector('#activity')
// One item per event (value defaults to 1), or one per day with a total.
heatmap.data = [
  { date: '2025-10-23', value: 6 },
  { date: '2025-10-24T14:05:00', value: 17 },
]
document.querySelector('moul-tabs').addEventListener('selectionchange', (e) => {
  heatmap.mode = e.detail.selectedKey
})
```

### `<moul-heatmap-chart>`

Class: `MoulHeatmapChart` · Source: `ui/src/components/HeatmapChart/HeatmapChart.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `mode` | `mode` | `'calendar' \| 'hour'` | `'calendar'` |
| `weeks` | `weeks` | `number` | `53` |
| `end-date` | `endDate` | `string` | `''` |
| `week-start` | `weekStart` | `number` | `0` |
| `unit` | `unit` | `string` | `'contributions'` |
| `unit-singular` | `unitSingular` | `string` | `''` |
| `color` | `color` | `string` | `''` |
| `hide-summary` | `hideSummary` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `hide-legend` | `hideLegend` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `activeIndex` | `activeIndex` | `number` | `-1` |
| `focusIndex` | `focusIndex` | `number` | `-1` |

**Properties** (JavaScript only — set on the element instance)

| Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `data` | `HeatmapDataItem[]` | `[]` |
| `valueFormatter` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `undefined` |

**Events**

| Event | Type |
| :--- | :--- |
| `point-hover` | `CustomEvent` |
| `point-leave` | `CustomEvent` |

**CSS Parts:** `base`, `summary`, `total`, `peak`, `grid`, `cell`, `legend`, `tooltip`, `scroller`

## FunnelChart

Ordered conversion steps as centered bars with per-step drop-off and an overall-conversion summary. Docs: [/docs/components/charts/funnelchart](/docs/components/charts/funnelchart)

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Signup funnel" description="Visit to paid, last 30 days">
  <moul-funnel-chart id="signups"></moul-funnel-chart>
</moul-chart-container>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#signups').data = [
  { label: 'Visited site', value: 48200 },
  { label: 'Signed up', value: 15840 },
  { label: 'Started paid plan', value: 1380 },
]
```

## ChartContainer

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Revenue" description="Last 30 days" height="320">
  <moul-area-chart x-key="month"></moul-area-chart>
  <span slot="empty">No data yet</span>
</moul-chart-container>
```

| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |
| `color` | `color` | `string` | `'var(--color-chart-1)'` |
| `is-open` | `isOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `x` | `x` | `number` | `0` |
| `y` | `y` | `number` | `0` |

**Properties** (JavaScript only — set on the element instance)

| Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `payload` | `(ChartTooltipPayloadEntry \| unknown)[]` | `[]` |
| `valueFormatter` | `(value: unknown) => string \| undefined` | `undefined` |

**Slots**

| Slot |
| :--- |
| (default) |

**CSS Parts:** `container`, `header`, `indicator`, `label`, `value`, `title`, `list`, `item`

# Actions & Toggles

## Button

Button with 7 variants, 3 sizes, icon-only mode, and pending, success and error states; `run(task)` drives them from a promise. For landing pages: `effect="shimmer|rainbow|neon"` animates the edge, `is-pulsing` adds a pulsing ring, and a `hover` slot swaps in on hover. Docs: [/docs/components/button](/docs/components/button)

```html
<moul-button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</moul-button>
<moul-button variant="ghost" is-icon aria-label="Close">×</moul-button>
<moul-button id="save">
  Save
  <span slot="pending">Saving…</span>
  <span slot="success">Saved</span>
</moul-button>
<moul-button size="lg" effect="shimmer" is-pulsing>
  Get started
  <span slot="hover">Read the docs →</span>
</moul-button>
```

```js
const save = document.querySelector('#save')
save.addEventListener('press', () => {
  save.run(() => fetch('/api/save', { method: 'POST' })).catch(() => {})
})
```

### `<moul-button>`

Class: `MoulButton` · Source: `ui/src/components/Button/Button.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `variant` | `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger' \| 'danger-soft'` | `'primary'` |
| `size` | `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |
| `type` | `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` |
| `state` | `state` | `'idle' \| 'pending' \| 'success' \| 'error'` | `'idle'` |
| `state-duration` | `stateDuration` | `number` | `2000` |
| `pending-label` | `pendingLabel` | `string` | `'Loading'` |
| `success-label` | `successLabel` | `string` | `'Done'` |
| `error-label` | `errorLabel` | `string` | `'Failed'` |
| `is-icon` | `isIcon` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-disabled` | `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-pending` | `isPending` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `effect` | `effect` | `'shimmer' \| 'rainbow' \| 'neon' \| undefined` | — |
| `is-pulsing` | `isPulsing` | `boolean` | `false` |

**Events**

| Event | Type |
| :--- | :--- |
| `press` | `CustomEvent` |

**Slots**

| Slot |
| :--- |
| (default) |
| `prefix` |
| `suffix` |
| `pending` |
| `success` |
| `error` |
| `hover` |

**CSS Parts:** `button`, `icon`, `prefix`, `content`, `hover`, `suffix`

## SlideToConfirm

Drag a handle across a track to confirm a risky action; a keyboard slider (arrows, `End`) reaches the same result. Docs: [/docs/components/slidetoconfirm](/docs/components/slidetoconfirm)

```html
<moul-slide-to-confirm tone="error" label="Slide to delete project" confirmed-label="Deleting"></moul-slide-to-confirm>
```

```js
slider.addEventListener('confirm', async () => {
  slider.isPending = true
  try { await deleteProject() } catch { slider.reset() } finally { slider.isPending = false }
})
```

### `<moul-slide-to-confirm>`

| `is-confirmed` | `isConfirmed` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-pending` | `isPending` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-disabled` | `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` |

# Inputs & Forms

## TextField

Form-associated text input with label, description, and error message. `placeholders` rotates the placeholder through hints; `vanish()` or `vanish-on-submit` scatters the text away and clears it after its form submits. Docs: [/docs/components/textfield](/docs/components/textfield)

```html
<moul-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" placeholder="you@example.com" is-required></moul-text-field>
<moul-text-field name="q" label="Search" vanish-on-submit></moul-text-field>
```

```js
document.querySelector('[name="q"]').placeholders = ['Search collections…', 'Find a record…']
```

## FileUpload

Drop zone and file list with per-file progress; set `upload` to send each file as it is picked. Docs: [/docs/components/fileupload](/docs/components/fileupload)

```html
<moul-file-upload name="attachments" label="Attachments" accept="image/*,.pdf" max-size="5242880" is-multiple></moul-file-upload>
```

```js
const field = document.querySelector('moul-file-upload')
field.upload = async (file, { signal, onProgress }) => {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('file', file)
  const res = await fetch('/api/files', { method: 'POST', body, signal })
  onProgress(100)
  return res.json() // stored on the item as `response`
}
```

### `<moul-file-upload>`

## Stepper

Multi-step flow with an animated connector; cancel `stepchange` to keep the user on a step that does not validate. Docs: [/docs/components/stepper](/docs/components/stepper)

```html
<moul-stepper id="checkout" current="0">
  <moul-step label="Cart" description="3 items">…</moul-step>
  <moul-step label="Delivery">…</moul-step>
  <moul-step label="Payment">…</moul-step>
</moul-stepper>
```

```js
const stepper = document.querySelector('#checkout')
stepper.addEventListener('stepchange', (e) => {
  if (e.detail.current > e.detail.previous && !isValid()) e.preventDefault()
})
stepper.next()
```

### `<moul-stepper>`

Class: `MoulStepper` · Source: `ui/src/components/Stepper/Stepper.ts`

## Tooltip

Hover/focus label that slides out of its trigger; `follow="pointer"` trails the pointer, `is-rich` makes a small non-interactive card with a `media` slot. Docs: [/docs/components/tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip)

```html
<moul-tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <moul-button is-icon aria-label="Copy">⧉</moul-button>
</moul-tooltip>
<moul-tooltip is-rich follow="pointer">
  <moul-avatar name="Sophea Chan" tabindex="0"></moul-avatar>
  <img slot="media" src="/sophea.jpg" alt="" />
  <span slot="content">Sophea Chan · Design</span>
</moul-tooltip>
```

### `<moul-tooltip>`

Class: `MoulTooltip` · Source: `ui/src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |

## HoverCard

Preview card beside a link or name on hover or keyboard focus; may hold links and buttons and stays open while the pointer is in it. Touch never opens it. Docs: [/docs/components/hovercard](/docs/components/hovercard)

```html
<moul-hover-card placement="bottom" open-delay="500" close-delay="300">
  <a slot="trigger" href="/people/sophea">@sophea</a>
  <strong>Sophea Chan</strong>
  <moul-button size="sm" variant="secondary">Follow</moul-button>
</moul-hover-card>
```

```js
card.addEventListener('openchange', (e) => console.log(e.detail.isOpen))
```

## Notification Bell

Bell button with an unread badge that swings when `count` rises and opens a panel listing its children. Docs: [/docs/components/notificationbell](/docs/components/notificationbell)

```html
<moul-notification-bell id="inbox" count="2">
  <moul-button slot="header-actions" size="sm" variant="ghost">Mark all read</moul-button>
  <div>Deploy finished</div>
  <div>New sign-up</div>
  <a slot="footer" href="/notifications">View all</a>
</moul-notification-bell>
```

```js
const bell = document.querySelector('#inbox')
bell.prepend(item)
bell.count += 1
await bell.removeItem(item)
```

## Tour

Product walkthrough in a modal dialog: the page dims except a cutout around each step's target, with a card of heading, body, progress and Back/Next/Done. Docs: [/docs/components/tour](/docs/components/tour)

```html
<moul-tour id="welcome">
  <moul-tour-step heading="Welcome">A quick look around.</moul-tour-step>
  <moul-tour-step target="#new" heading="Start a project">Everything lives in a project.</moul-tour-step>
  <moul-tour-step target="#invite" heading="Bring your team" placement="right">Invite people by email.</moul-tour-step>
</moul-tour>
```

```js
const tour = document.querySelector('#welcome')
tour.start()
tour.addEventListener('openchange', (e) => {
  if (!e.detail.isOpen && e.detail.isComplete) localStorage.setItem('tour', 'done')
})
```

## FocusMode

Dims the page around the region it wraps (or `target`); clicks pass through the cutout, and a click on the dim or `Escape` ends it. Visual only, not modal. Docs: [/docs/components/focusmode](/docs/components/focusmode)

```html
<moul-focus-mode id="draft">
  <moul-text-area label="Release notes"></moul-text-area>
</moul-focus-mode>
```

## Animated List

Feed whose new children grow in and push the others along; `removeItem()` shrinks one away while the rest close ranks, and `is-live` announces arrivals. Docs: [/docs/components/animatedlist](/docs/components/animatedlist)

```html
<moul-animated-list id="feed" is-live>
  <div class="event">Deploy finished</div>
  <div class="event">New sign-up</div>
</moul-animated-list>
```

```js
const feed = document.querySelector('#feed')
feed.prepend(newEventElement) // animates in
await feed.removeItem(feed.items.at(-1))
```

## NumberTicker

Number that rolls like an odometer (or counts with `mode="count"`) to each new `value`; Intl formatting via `locale` and `formatOptions`, and `from` counts up on first view. Docs: [/docs/components/numberticker](/docs/components/numberticker)

```html
<moul-number-ticker value="1280" from="0"></moul-number-ticker>
```

```js
const ticker = document.querySelector('moul-number-ticker')
ticker.formatOptions = { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }
ticker.value = 1530
```

## StepLoader

Checklist that ticks off the steps of a long task: drawn checks for done steps, a spinner on the current one; `interval` advances it by itself and `is-error` marks a failure. Docs: [/docs/components/steploader](/docs/components/steploader)

```html
<moul-step-loader id="publish" label="Publishing site"></moul-step-loader>
```

```js
const loader = document.querySelector('#publish')
loader.steps = ['Checking files', { label: 'Uploading', description: '12 files' }, 'Publishing']
loader.addEventListener('complete', () => console.log('done'))
loader.current = 1 // or loader.isError = true
```

### `<moul-step-loader>`

| `is-error` | `isError` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `'Progress'` |

## Table

Data table with search, filters, sorting, row selection, expandable rows and a card layout on narrow screens; `is-manual` hands search, filters and sorting to the server. Docs: [/docs/components/table](/docs/components/table)

```html
<moul-table id="users" aria-label="Team members" is-searchable is-sortable is-selectable>
  <span slot="caption">Team members</span>
  <span slot="empty">No members yet</span>
</moul-table>
```

```js
import { html } from 'lit'

const table = document.querySelector('#users')
table.columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role', filterOptions: [{ value: 'Admin', label: 'Admin' }, { value: 'Member', label: 'Member' }] },
  // render() puts markup in the cell; it runs inside the table's shadow root.
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', render: (row) => html`<moul-badge tone="success">${row.status}</moul-badge>` },
]
table.data = [{ id: '1', name: 'Dara', role: 'Admin', status: 'Active' }]
table.renderExpanded = (row) => html`<p>${row.name} joined in 2024.</p>`
```

### `<moul-table>`

Class: `MoulTable` · Source: `ui/src/components/Table/Table.ts`

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `data` | `data` | `readonly object[]` | `[]` |
| `columns` | `columns` | `TableColumn[]` | `[]` |
| `is-sortable` | `isSortable` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-selectable` | `isSelectable` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-searchable` | `isSearchable` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-manual` | `isManual` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-loading` | `isLoading` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `is-dense` | `isDense` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `selected-keys` | `selectedKeys` | `string[]` | `[]` |
| `sort-column` | `sortColumn` | `string` | `''` |

## Toast

Transient notifications queued with `toastQueue.add()`: swipe to dismiss, an optional stacked deck (`is-stacked`, `toastQueue.isStacked`), and undo toasts with an `action` button and a `showCountdown` bar. Timers pause on hover, swipe and keyboard focus. Docs: [/docs/components/toast](/docs/components/toast)

```html
<moul-toast-region is-stacked></moul-toast-region>
<moul-toast title="3 rows deleted" duration="8000" show-countdown>
  <moul-button slot="action" size="sm" variant="secondary">Undo</moul-button>
</moul-toast>
```

```js
import { toastQueue } from '@moul-dev/web-component'

toastQueue.add({
  title: '3 rows deleted',
  duration: 8000,
  showCountdown: true,
  action: { label: 'Undo', onAction: () => restoreRows() },
})
```

```html
  </div>
</moul-expandable-card>
```

## Confetti

Confetti burst or rocket on success, from the effects entry (`import '@moul-dev/web-component/effects'`); decorative, skipped under reduced motion. Docs: [/docs/components/confetti](/docs/components/confetti)

```html
<moul-confetti>
  <moul-button id="pay">Pay $120</moul-button>
</moul-confetti>
```


## HistoryLedger

Version history of a record, newest first, with before→after field changes and one-click restore. Docs: [/docs/components/historyledger](/docs/components/historyledger)

```html
<moul-history-ledger id="history"></moul-history-ledger>
```

```js
const history = document.querySelector('#history')
history.versions = [
  { id: 'v2', label: 'Version 2', author: 'Dara', timestamp: Date.now(), summary: 'Published',
    changes: [{ field: 'Status', before: 'Draft', after: 'Published' }] },
  { id: 'v1', label: 'Version 1', author: 'Dara', timestamp: Date.now() - 86400000 },
]
history.current = 'v2'
history.addEventListener('restore', (e) => e.detail.waitUntil(api.restore(e.detail.version.id)))
```

## RelationshipGraph

Layered graph of nodes and links (source depends on target); hovering, focusing or selecting a node traces its upstream dependencies and downstream dependents. Docs: [/docs/components/relationshipgraph](/docs/components/relationshipgraph)

```html
<moul-relationship-graph id="services" label="Service map" trace="both" show-legend></moul-relationship-graph>
```

```js
const graph = document.querySelector('#services')
graph.nodes = [
  { id: 'web', label: 'Web app', group: 'Clients' },
  { id: 'api', label: 'API', group: 'Services' },
  { id: 'db', label: 'Postgres', group: 'Data' },
]
graph.links = [
  { source: 'web', target: 'api', label: 'calls' },
  { source: 'api', target: 'db' },
]
graph.addEventListener('node-action', (e) => console.log(e.detail.id))
```

## AgentActivity

An AI agent's reasoning steps and tool calls as a live compact timeline with status and timing; a tool call's input and output open as highlighted JSON, and the header sums the run up and folds it away. Docs: [/docs/components/agentactivity](/docs/components/agentactivity)

```html
<moul-agent-activity id="activity" is-live></moul-agent-activity>
```

```js
const activity = document.querySelector('#activity')
activity.push({ id: 'call_1', tool: 'list_records', input: { collection: 'posts' }, status: 'running', startedAt: Date.now() })
activity.push({ id: 'call_1', status: 'done', output: { items: [] }, endedAt: Date.now() })
```

## Chat

A complete AI chat screen: conversation history sidebar, user bubbles, assistant turns with tool calls, a thinking indicator and streamed Markdown answers, suggestions while empty, and a prompt-input composer. It calls no model itself: listen for `promptsubmit` and feed replies back with `push()`, `pushSteps()`, `appendText()` and `updateMessage()`. Docs: [/docs/components/chat](/docs/components/chat)

```html
<moul-chat id="chat" allow-attachments>
  <span slot="footer">Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.</span>
</moul-chat>
```

```js
const chat = document.querySelector('#chat')
chat.suggestions = ['Which collections are there?']
chat.addEventListener('promptsubmit', async (e) => {
  const reply = crypto.randomUUID()
  chat.push({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: e.detail.value }, { id: reply, role: 'assistant', status: 'pending' })
  for await (const part of streamAgent(e.detail.value)) {
    if (part.type === 'tool_call') chat.pushSteps(reply, { id: part.id, tool: part.name, input: part.input, status: 'running' })
    if (part.type === 'tool_result') chat.pushSteps(reply, { id: part.id, output: part.output, status: 'done' })
    if (part.type === 'text') chat.appendText(reply, part.text)
  }
  chat.updateMessage(reply, { status: 'done' })
})
chat.addEventListener('stop', () => controller.abort())
```

### `<moul-chat>`

Class: `MoulChat` · Source: `ui/src/components/Chat/Chat.ts`

## PromptInput

Chat composer: auto-growing textarea where Enter sends (IME-safe, Shift+Enter for a new line), Arrow Up recalls history, a model picker, file attachments by button, paste or drop with optional uploads, rotating placeholder hints, and a send button that becomes Stop while `is-generating`. Docs: [/docs/components/promptinput](/docs/components/promptinput)

```html
<moul-prompt-input id="composer" allow-attachments accept="image/*,.pdf"></moul-prompt-input>
```

```js
const composer = document.querySelector('#composer')
composer.models = [{ value: 'sonnet', label: 'Sonnet' }, { value: 'opus', label: 'Opus' }]
composer.placeholders = ['Ask about your collections…', 'Summarise errors…']
composer.addEventListener('promptsubmit', (e) => send(e.detail.value, e.detail.attachments, e.detail.model))
composer.addEventListener('stop', () => controller.abort())
```

## StreamingResponse

A model's Markdown answer that reveals smoothly as it streams, with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, `[n]` citations linked to `sources`, and copy, regenerate and feedback actions once done. Rendered as text, never HTML; images become links and only http, https, mailto and relative links are kept. Docs: [/docs/components/streamingresponse](/docs/components/streamingresponse)

```html
<moul-streaming-response id="answer" is-streaming></moul-streaming-response>
```

```js
const answer = document.querySelector('#answer')
for await (const chunk of stream) answer.appendText(chunk)
answer.isStreaming = false
answer.sources = [{ title: 'Records API', url: 'https://moul.dev/docs/records' }]
```

### `<moul-streaming-response>`

Class: `MoulStreamingResponse` · Source: `ui/src/components/StreamingResponse/StreamingResponse.ts`

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `is-streaming` | `isStreaming` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `actions` | `actions` | `string` | `'copy regenerate feedback'` |
| `feedback` | `feedback` | `'up' \| 'down' \| ''` | `''` |
| `error` | `error` | `string` | `''` |
| `heading-level` | `headingLevel` | `number` | `3` |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `'Response'` |
| `lightContent` | `lightContent` | `string` | `''` |

**CSS Parts:** `base`, `content`, `caret`, `error`, `sources`, `source`, `actions`, `action-button`

# Landing Kit

## Reveal

Wraps content that fades in and sharpens from a blur as it scrolls into view, once (or on every entry with `is-repeating`); `stagger` reveals child elements in turn. Effects entry (`import '@moul-dev/web-component/effects'`); shown at once under reduced motion. Docs: [/docs/components/reveal](/docs/components/reveal)

```html
<moul-reveal direction="up" delay="150">
  <h2>Ship on Friday</h2>
</moul-reveal>
<moul-reveal stagger="90" class="feature-grid">
  <moul-card>…</moul-card>
  <moul-card>…</moul-card>
</moul-reveal>
```

## Marquee
